items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: The interviewee narrates stories about Chris Kelly and Buddy Petit involving a 'Captain', but never claims a personal relationship with the Captain, only mentioning him in the context of others' interactions or as a title used by others.

ctx.x: Man that was some kick them did. See the musician done the thing there? The boy was in the truck doing that. You understand any of them? You'd get yourself in trouble for that. That's when they got the union. You'd do something like that. You'd just have no word trouble for the union. And them fellas would be taking money. They'd take your deposit you know. Well Chris Kelly, you'd do the same with it too. He would do that with it too? Yeah he'd done that with it. He'd done that too. Take deposit. When they go to…
Captain. Man. Cut. Man. What's the matter with you Buddy. Nothing. Captain. Man. I just had a little bad night.

You don't want to get that home. Yeah. I said. Captain. I'm going with you. Chris Kelly said. You don't want to come. I'm coming. I'm coming. I'm going to come get you. So. Guy out there. Buddy got on one side. One side there. And blew that Chris. This bucket one. Another on the bandstand. That was kick with him. What happened. Manuel Perez. Was at Nace Camp. One of them like that. And boy. Manuel was shooting the music man. That was a powerful man. Well Manuel had a band. Of course they had a good band. They had…
